incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 -> runtime-prefill GPU OOM spike in eu-central-1. service=runtime-prefill cluster=rw-euc1-gpu nodes=6. multiple containers restarting. https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-078
nicole_sre: on it. seeing repeated cuda alloc failures on prefill pods. pulling crash logs
tom_ops: pulling node metrics + driver logs now
lina_prod: noticed sudden surge of long-stream requests from a single customer API key (cust=acme-dataworks). sample trace id=trc-77a9; prompt size ~180k tokens
dev_ml: likely path: prefill tries to allocate full KV + activations for long sequence -> cuMemAlloc fails. we also saw driver reset: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1d): 100`
```stderr
2026-03-15T03:05:42Z runtime ERROR: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: cuMemAlloc failed size=4096 MiB
prefill: allocation request for seq_len=131072 tokens, kv_cache_est=14GiB
Container exit code=137 (OOMKilled)
```
nicole_sre: nodes with restarts: eu-n1-04, eu-n1-05. total 9 container restarts in 6m.
tom_ops: taking rapid mitigations: 1) attach ingress rule to rate-limit /v1/generate for token_count>100k to 429 2) enable PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=131072 env 3) route >100k to cpu-fallback pool 4) cordon node eu-n1-05 for investigation
lina_prod: I'm going to notify affected customers and support has ticket SUP-4881 opened. initial impact: 6 customers had truncated streams / mid-generation 500s for ~5-8m
dev_ml: quick hotfix: toggle PREFILL_KV_DISABLED=true on runtime-prefill deployment to prevent large KV allocations. will cause some latency but avoids OOMs
deploy-bot: rolling update started: runtime-prefill v2026.03.15-hotfix3 (PREFILL_KV_DISABLED=true, PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=131072)
tom_ops: applied ingress rate-limit patch via envoy: route filter triggered for token_count>100k -> 429. patch id=rl-20260315-1
```sh
kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/runtime-prefill PREFILL_KV_DISABLED=true PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=131072
kubectl cordon node/eu-n1-05
kubectl drain node/eu-n1-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
morgan_oncall: taking handoff in 15m. please confirm monitoring alerts to watch: prefill_oom_count, container_restart_count, 5xx_rate by customer_key, envoy_429_rate
nicole_sre: after env flip and routing change OOMs dropped to 0 in the last 3m, restarts reduced from 9->1. node eu-n1-04 still shows high gpu memory pressure but stable
lina_prod: customer comms: sent initial notice to 6 customers, outlined workaround to split very long prompts and suggested using embeddings for summarization. support-bot recorded SUP-4881 with affected customers list
dev_ml: propose follow-ups: - implement streaming prefill (incremental KV build) - soft caps at router with backpressure (instead of hard 429) - per-model kv-size heuristics - model variant downgrade for >64k tokens
tom_ops: long-term infra: investigate driver resets cause (firmware/driver mismatch?), scheduled maintenance window to test driver update on a canary node
morgan_oncall: handoff accepted. will keep incident open for 60m and escalate if OOMs or restarts recur
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-078 status: mitigated -> active monitoring. Severity downgraded to SRE-Medium. Next update in 1h or sooner on material change.
